As a Duty Trainee, you have a good knowledge of all operational departments and are happy to help them in times of need! Complaints are a challenge for you because you are an excellent problem solver with a sense of humor and can turn any complaint or issue into a brilliant and spirited experience!

• You will check rooms to verify the outside cleaning company.
• Making orders
• Other projects

• You are eager to learn and creative

In this position you will develop AI models to improve the lives of patients with psychiatric disorders. Interested? Apply now! In this project, you will develop predictive AI models that support clinically actionable outcomes for psychiatric disorders such as depression and schizophrenia. Working closely with (neuro)scientists and clinicians, you will translate cutting-edge AI methods into solutions for real-world clinical challenges. Your research will span a broad range of modelstopics, including deep learning, causal machine learning, distributed learning, unsupervised learning, foundation models, natural language processing, and explainable AI. A key challenge is that psychiatric research often relies on relatively small datasets, that while biomedical data are limited, and that data are subject to strict privacy requirements. You will work with a rich variety of data sources, including clinical data, (unstructured) electronic health records, MRI, time-series data (such as EEG, functional MRI, speech, and video), omics data, and mobile sensing. Amsterdam UMC offers access to extensive large datasets for model development and diagnostics, while also providing a unique opportunity to develop AI models for actionable problems for methods that remain effective in the small-data settings that are common in psychiatric research. You will develop innovative AI tools to improve the diagnosis, prognosis, and treatment of psychiatric disorders such as depression and schizophrenia. You will initiate and lead AI research projects in close collaboration with clinicians and researchers, combining cutting-edge AI methods with pressing clinical challenges. In addition to conducting your own research, you will (co-)supervise PhD candidates and initiate research projects for AI _tudents, helping to foster the next generation of researchers. You will also (co-)lead the department’s data science interest group, contribute to regional collaborations on data sharing, and actively

acquire funding to expand and sustain this line of research. You have a (nearly completed) PhD in AI and a strong scientific track record; You have experience with biomedical data analysis, image analysis, time-series analysis and/or unstructured data; You have excellent communication skills and command of written and oral English. Basic command of Dutch is preferred; You enjoy working in a multidisciplinary environment together with clinicians and are dedicated to developing clinical applications for psychiatry. One-year contract with possible extension for one more year. Further extension is dependent on additional funding. Classification in salary scale 10 or 11: € 3.724 to € 6.825 gross for full-time employment (depending on education and experience). In addition to a good basic salary, we offer 8.3% end-of-year bonus. Calculate your net salary here. Holiday hours: 194.4 per year based on full-time employment and possibility to save additional hours. 100% reimbursement for public transport travel costs. If you travel by foot, bicycle, or car, a mileage allowance of €0.21 per km applies (up to a maximum of 40 km one way by car). Do you prefer walking or cycling? Take advantage of our good bike scheme. Pension accrual with the ABP, of which we pay 70% of the premium. Free and unlimited access to our online learning environment GoodHabitz. jobs.occupation: Assistant professor in infectious diseases (tenure track)
jobs.description:
Do you want to establish an independent research programme in infectious diseases, immunology or microbiology? At CIMM, you will have protected time, strong support and an outstanding scientific environment to become an internationally visible research leader. As an Assistant Professor on the CIMM tenure track, you will establish and lead an innovative, independent and sustainable research programme in infectious diseases, immunology or microbiology. Your programme may focus on acute infections and/or post-acute infection syndromes, should complement and strengthen CIMM's portfolio, and may be fun_amental, translational or combine both approaches. Clinical research and structural clinical duties are outside the scope of this position. The indicative allocation of duties is 80% research, 10% teaching and 10% academic leadership, management, outreach and societal engagement.
